lines.text: Looking back at pictures from the last year, I sometimes wonder… how did so much happen in such little time?
Somewhere along the way, I found myself raising two babies.
One was my little one… and the other was GLOSSKN.
And honestly, nothing could have prepared me for this year.
There were days when I felt like I was doing everything, and somehow, still not doing enough.
Between being a mother, managing everyday life, and building a brand, things rarely went according to plan.
But GLOSSKN gave me something that was truly my own.
A dream to nurture, ideas to explore, and a part of myself I didn't want to lose along the way.
After years of working in the beauty industry, there were things I wanted to do differently.
And GLOSSKN was my chance to turn those thoughts into something real.
Of course, there were mistakes, setbacks, moments of doubt… and so much learning.
But one thing this year has taught me is how important it is to remember your why.
Why you started. What you believe in. And what you want to stand for.
Because when things get difficult, that purpose is what brings you back.
And strangely, watching my little one grow reminded me of something I had forgotten.
Children don't wait to have everything figured out. They fall, get up, and try again.
And that's exactly what this year has been for me.
Somewhere between raising a child and building a dream, I didn't just watch them grow… I grew too.
So here's to the little wins,
the lessons, the people who believed in us,
and everything that's still to come.
Happy first birthday, GLOSSKN.
